bull.point: Revenue shows strong compounding growth momentum over the long term.
bull.evidence: Revenue compounded 25.6% a year over 3 years.

bull.point: Management targets aggressive customer acquisition and loan volume growth for FY27.
bull.evidence: Guidance to add 18 MM to 20 MM customers and 60-62 million new loans.

bull.point: Efficiency is expected to improve through opex-to-NTI reduction and AI-driven volumes.
bull.evidence: Targeting 25 to 40 basis point improvement in opex-to-NTI and INR 100,000 crores volume via AI/tech.

bear.point: Profitability is lagging behind revenue growth, indicating margin compression.
bear.evidence: Profit grew slower than revenue (18.9% vs 25.6% 3y CAGR).

bear.point: The company consistently generates negative free cash flow and poor cash conversion.
bear.evidence: FCF was -66,686.0 Cr in Mar 2026 with a CFO to PAT of -340.32%.

bear.point: Asset quality concerns are emerging in specific segments and consumer leverage.
bear.evidence: Analyst concerns regarding MSME GNPA deterioration and Stage 2 asset increases in gold loans.

watch_next: Achievement of 145 to 160 bps credit cost metric guidance.
Impact of interest rates on NIM moderation and ROA targets of 4.4%-4.6%.
Gold loan portfolio growth toward the 5% total AUM target by FY27.
